name: SimplyIrfan AI Content Discovery
author: Irfan

sections.description:
SimplyIrfan AI Content Discovery creates a site-level AI discovery registry from explicit site-owner information and verifiable public interfaces.

Unlike a content index alone, the registry describes both identity and declared read-only capabilities, while the verification system checks whether advertised interfaces are actually reachable.

No AI API, external AI service, embeddings, or generated AI content are required.

Features

  • Machine-readable discovery registry at /ai-content-discovery.json.
  • REST registry at /wp-json/si-aicd/v1/registry.
  • Explicit brand identity and voice fields.
  • Declared read-only agent capabilities.
  • Safe verification of same-site public endpoints.
  • Detection of REST, sitemap, RSS, JSON-LD, OpenAPI, AI crawler policy signals, and Markdown integration.
  • No external AI API.

Privacy

The plugin does not send site content to an external service. Verification requests are made to the site’s own public URLs and results are stored locally in a WordPress transient.
sections.changelog:
1.2.9

  • Fix canonical handling so the discovery JSON URL does not receive a trailing slash.
  • Prevent WordPress canonical redirects from changing the discovery endpoint URL.
  • Fix admin capability input sanitization warnings.
  • Keep the canonical discovery URL without a trailing slash.
  • Synchronize the plugin version constant with the plugin header.

1.2.2

  • Fix sitemap verification and same-origin handling.
  • Make the discovery JSON URL canonical without a trailing slash.
  • Report the actual plugin version in the discovery manifest.
  • Avoid advertising configured capabilities that fail verification.

1.2.0

  • Introduced the AI discovery contract and safe verification layer.
